title: RPA DNA Amplification using Agdia AmplifyRP® Acceler8® Discovery Kit
author: Théo Nass
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8ephtdn

steps.title: Prepare RPA pellet rehydration solution
steps.instruction: Prepare the RPA pellet rehydration solution according to the Materials section table, creating a Master Mix for division if possible.

steps.title: Resuspend reaction pellets
steps.instruction: Transfer 10 µl of the prepared solution to each reaction pellet and pipette up and down until the pellet is fully resuspended.

steps.title: Mix and centrifuge samples
steps.instruction: Cap the reaction tubes, then vortex and spin briefly two times.

steps.title: Incubate reactions
steps.instruction: Transfer the reaction tubes to a heat block and incubate at 39°C for 20 min.

steps.title: Purify RPA product
steps.instruction: If the product is to be run on an agarose gel, purify the sample using a PCR purification kit with a high cutoff (recommended due to RPA primers being 60+ bp).
